, Step Number: 11
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner miscompared the directors’ birth years. Julia Crawford Ivers was born in 1869 and T. V. Chandran in 1950; therefore, the later-born director is T. V. Chandran (Bhoomiyude Avakashikal). The Planner appears to have misread “’69” as 1969 and concluded incorrectly that The Majesty of the Law’s director was born later.
